Mazraoui's Morocco Performance Sparks Debate Among Manchester United Fans

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Morocco's Authenticity and Modernity Party wins parliamentary election. [1]
King Mohammed VI stated that any attack on KSA is an attack on Morocco. [4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR MOROCCO
The election win by the Authenticity and Modernity Party may affect Morocco's energy policy given the country's net energy import dependency of 94%. [1][E3]

KEY RISKS
Morocco's 94% net energy import dependency exposes it to supply disruptions at the Strait of Gibraltar chokepoint. [E3][E4]
Morocco is linked to 2 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, which could affect international transactions. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the Polymarket market on whether Aziz Akhannouch will be out as Morocco Prime Minister by December 31, 2026 remains unresolved. [E5]

evidence.label: US OFAC and Canada SEMA designations
evidence.factText: Morocco is linked to 2 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Sep 28, 2026.

evidence.label: Net energy import dependency
evidence.factText: Morocco has a net energy import dependency of 94% (World Bank Open Data, 2023).

evidence.label: Chokepoint tracker
evidence.factText: Strait of Gibraltar is a shipping chokepoint World Monitor tracks for Morocco.

evidence.label: Polymarket prediction market
evidence.factText: A Polymarket market related to Morocco, "Aziz Akhannouch out as Morocco Prime Minister by December 31, 2026?", priced Yes at 91% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027.
